_comment: Shared style lines for every N5 hint image, applied by generate.py on top of each word's own prompt.
style: Simple flat vector illustration in a clean modern infographic style. One clear subject, centred, filling the frame, on a plain pale background. Bold clean linework, minimal detail, still readable at 200 pixels wide. Draw exactly and only what is described. No letters, no words, no captions, no labels, no Japanese or Chinese characters, no signage, no logos, no watermark. Digits only where the description explicitly asks for them. Not an anime or manga character, not a portrait, not a scene with a story: an icon-like picture of the thing described.
style_text: Simple flat vector illustration in a clean modern infographic style. One clear subject, centred, filling the frame, on a plain pale background. Bold clean linework, minimal detail. Render every piece of text quoted in the description exactly as written, in plain Latin letters and Arabic digits, large and legible. Draw exactly and only what is described. No other lettering: no extra captions, no labels, no Japanese or Chinese characters, no signage, no logos, no watermark. Not an anime or manga character, not a portrait, not a scene with a story: an icon-like picture of the thing described.
